## Step-by-Step Instructions

### Step 1: [First Major Step - e.g., "Create Your Project"]

**What we'll do:** [Brief explanation of this step's purpose]

**Time:** ~[X] minutes

---

#### 1.1 [Sub-step title - e.g., "Navigate to Projects"]

**Instructions:**

1. **Log in** to your account at [example.com](https://example.com)
   
2. **Click** the "Projects" tab in the main navigation
   
   ![Screenshot: Projects tab location](https://placeholder.com/projects-tab.png)
   
3. **Look for** the project list view
   - You should see any existing projects
   - Or "No projects yet" if this is your first

**💡 Tip:** Use the keyboard shortcut `Ctrl+Shift+P` (Windows) or `Cmd+Shift+P` (Mac) to quickly open the project creation dialog.

---

#### 1.2 [Next sub-step - e.g., "Create New Project"]

1. **Click** the "**+ New Project**" button in the top-right corner
   
2. **Choose** a project template (or start from blank):
   
   | Template | Best For | Features Included |
   |----------|----------|-------------------|
   | **Blank Project** | Custom workflows | Empty canvas |
   | **Marketing Campaign** | Marketing teams | Campaign tasks, content calendar |
   | **Product Launch** | Product teams | Sprint planning, roadmap |
   | **Event Planning** | Event teams | Timeline, vendor tracking |
   
   For this tutorial: **Select "Marketing Campaign"**

3. **Click** "Continue"

**📸 What you should see:**
[Screenshot showing the template selection screen]

---

#### 1.3 [Configure basic settings]

You'll now configure basic project settings:

1. **Project Name:** Enter a descriptive name
   - ✅ Good: "Q1 2026 Product Launch Campaign"
   - ❌ Bad: "New Project" or "Test"
   
   **For this tutorial, use:** `"Tutorial: Marketing Campaign Setup"`

2. **Description:** Add context about the project
   ```
   Example:
   "This is a tutorial project demonstrating campaign setup, 
   team collaboration, and automation workflows."
   ```

3. **Due Date:** Set the project deadline
   - Click the calendar icon
   - Choose a date 30 days from today
   - This helps with planning and urgency

4. **Project Visibility:**
   - **Private** - Only invited members can see
   - **Team** - Everyone in your organization can see
   - **Public** - Anyone with the link can view
   
   **Select:** Private (for this tutorial)

5. **Click** "**Create Project**"

**⏱️ What happens next:**
- Project is created (takes ~2 seconds)
- You're redirected to the project dashboard
- Project appears in your project list

---

#### 1.4 [Verify creation]

**Let's confirm everything worked:**

✅ **Checklist:**
- [ ] You see the project dashboard
- [ ] Project name appears in the top-left
- [ ] Due date shows in the project header
- [ ] You see template tasks (if you selected a template)

**❓ Not seeing the project?**
- Check the Projects list (left sidebar)
- Try refreshing the page (F5)
- See [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) section

---

### Step 2: [Second Major Step - e.g., "Set Up Your Team"]

**What we'll do:** Invite team members and assign roles

**Time:** ~[X] minutes

**Why this matters:** Collaboration is key to project success. Setting up your team correctly ensures everyone has the right access and permissions.

---

#### 2.1 [Invite team members]

1. **Click** the "**Team**" tab or the team icon (👥) in the project header

2. **Click** "**+ Invite Members**" button

3. **Enter email addresses:**
   - Type email and press Enter after each
   - Or paste multiple emails separated by commas
   
   ```
   Example:
   sarah@example.com, john@example.com, mike@example.com
   ```
   
   **For this tutorial:** Invite at least 2 team members (or use test emails)

4. **Choose notification preference:**
   - ☑️ "Send invitation email" (recommended)
   - Leave checked so members get notified

---

#### 2.2 [Assign roles]

For each team member, select a role:

| Role | Permissions | Best For |
|------|-------------|----------|
| **Owner** | Full access, can delete project | Project leads, managers |
| **Editor** | Create, edit, delete tasks/content | Core team members |
| **Viewer** | Read-only access | Stakeholders, clients |

**How to assign:**

1. **Find the team member** in the invite dialog
2. **Click** the dropdown next to their email
3. **Select role:**
   - Member 1: **Editor**
   - Member 2: **Editor**
   - (You're already Owner)

4. **Add optional message:**
   ```
   Example:
   "Welcome to the Q1 campaign project! Let's collaborate 
   to make this launch successful. Check out the tasks 
   already set up and feel free to add your own."
   ```

5. **Click** "**Send Invitations**" (or "Add Members" if notification unchecked)

---

#### 2.3 [Verify team setup]

**What happens:**
- Team members receive email invitations
- They appear in your Team list with "Pending" status
- Once they accept, status changes to "Active"

**View your team:**
1. Team tab shows all members
2. Status indicators: Active ✅ | Pending ⏳ | Declined ❌

**For this tutorial:** Continue even if invites are pending (team members can join later)

---

### Step 3: [Third Major Step - e.g., "Create and Organize Tasks"]

**What we'll do:** Add tasks, organize them, and set priorities

**Time:** ~[X] minutes

---

#### 3.1 [Create your first task]

1. **Navigate to Tasks view:**
   - Click "**Tasks**" tab
   - Or use keyboard shortcut: `T`

2. **Click** "**+ Add Task**" button

3. **Fill in task details:**

   **Task Name:** `"Create campaign landing page"`
   
   **Description:** Add context
   ```
   Design and develop the landing page for our Q1 campaign.
   
   Requirements:
   - Mobile responsive
   - Include hero image, CTA, features section
   - Integrate with analytics
   - Deploy to staging for review
   ```
   
   **Assignee:** Select team member (or yourself)
   - Click "Assignee" dropdown
   - Choose from team members
   
   **Due Date:** Set deadline
   - Click calendar
   - Choose date 1 week from today
   
   **Priority:** Set importance
   - High 🔴 - Critical, blocking work
   - Medium 🟡 - Important, should complete soon
   - Low 🟢 - Nice to have, not urgent
   
   **Select:** High (for this task)
   
   **Labels/Tags:** Categorize task (optional)
   - Type to search/create: `design`, `development`, `marketing`
   - Press Enter after each

4. **Click** "**Create Task**"

**💾 Task is saved!** You'll see it appear in your task list.

---

#### 3.2 [Create additional tasks]

**Let's add more tasks to build out the campaign:**

**Quick Add Method:**
1. Use the "**Quick Add**" input at the top of task list
2. Type task name and press Enter
3. Tasks are created instantly with default settings
4. Edit later to add details

**Create these tasks using Quick Add:**
- `Write campaign email copy`
- `Design email template`
- `Set up email automation`
- `Create social media graphics`
- `Schedule social posts`
- `Set up Google Ads campaign`

**Result:** You now have 7 tasks total

---

#### 3.3 [Organize tasks]

**Group tasks into sections:**

1. **Create sections** to categorize tasks:
   
   - Click "**+ Add Section**"
   - Name: `"Landing Page"`
   - Drag "Create campaign landing page" into this section
   
   - Create section: `"Email Marketing"`
   - Drag email-related tasks here
   
   - Create section: `"Social Media"`
   - Drag social tasks here
   
   - Create section: `"Paid Ads"`
   - Drag ads task here

**📋 Your task list structure:**
```
📁 Landing Page
  └─ Create campaign landing page

📁 Email Marketing
  └─ Write campaign email copy
  └─ Design email template
  └─ Set up email automation

📁 Social Media
  └─ Create social media graphics
  └─ Schedule social posts

📁 Paid Ads
  └─ Set up Google Ads campaign
```

**💡 Tip:** Drag and drop tasks between sections to reorganize

---

#### 3.4 [Set task dependencies]

**Create task order:**

Some tasks must be completed before others can start.

1. **Click** on "Design email template" task to open details
2. **Find** "Dependencies" section
3. **Click** "Add dependency"
4. **Select:** "Write campaign email copy"
   - This means the template can't be designed until copy is written
5. **Save**

**Repeat for:**
- "Set up email automation" depends on "Design email template"
- "Schedule social posts" depends on "Create social media graphics"

**📊 Visual indicator:** Tasks with dependencies show a link icon 🔗

---

### Step 4: [Fourth Major Step - e.g., "Configure Project Settings"]

**What we'll do:** Customize project settings for your workflow

**Time:** ~[X] minutes

---

#### 4.1 [Adjust project preferences]

1. **Click** the "**Settings**" ⚙️ icon in the project header
   
2. **General Settings:**
   
   **Default task view:**
   - List (default)
   - Board (Kanban)
   - Calendar
   - Timeline (Gantt)
   
   **Select:** Board (we'll use Kanban view for this project)
   
   **Task auto-archiving:**
   - Auto-archive completed tasks after: `30 days`
   - This keeps your active list clean
   
   **Notifications:**
   - ☑️ Email me when tasks are assigned to me
   - ☑️ Email me when I'm @mentioned
   - ☑️ Daily digest of project activity
   - ☐ Email for every project update (can be noisy)

3. **Click** "**Save Settings**"

---

#### 4.2 [Customize task fields]

Add custom fields relevant to your campaign:

1. **Settings** → **Custom Fields**
2. **Click** "+ Add Custom Field"

**Field 1: Campaign Phase**
- **Field Name:** `Campaign Phase`
- **Field Type:** Dropdown (single-select)
- **Options:**
  - Planning
  - In Progress
  - Review
  - Launched
  - Completed
- **Click** "Create"

**Field 2: Budget Allocated**
- **Field Name:** `Budget Allocated`
- **Field Type:** Number
- **Format:** Currency (USD)
- **Click** "Create"

**Field 3: Content Type**
- **Field Name:** `Content Type`
- **Field Type:** Dropdown (multi-select)
- **Options:**
  - Email
  - Social Media
  - Landing Page
  - Paid Ads
  - Blog Post
- **Click** "Create"

**Now these fields appear on all tasks in this project!**

---

#### 4.3 [Set up automation]

**Automate repetitive actions:**

1. **Settings** → **Automation**
2. **Click** "+ Create Automation"

**Automation 1: Auto-assign tasks**
- **Name:** `Auto-assign design tasks`
- **Trigger:** When task is created
- **Condition:** Task name contains "design" OR labels contain "design"
- **Action:** Assign to [select team member - e.g., "Sarah (Designer)"]
- **Click** "Create"

**Automation 2: Move to Review**
- **Name:** `Move completed tasks to Review`
- **Trigger:** When task status changes to "Completed"
- **Action 1:** Move task to section "Review"
- **Action 2:** Add comment: "✅ Task completed and ready for review"
- **Action 3:** Assign to [project owner for review]
- **Click** "Create"

**Automation 3: Due date reminder**
- **Name:** `Remind assignee 2 days before due date`
- **Trigger:** Task due date is in 2 days
- **Condition:** Task status is not "Completed"
- **Action:** Send notification to assignee
- **Click** "Create"

**💫 Automations are now active!** They'll run automatically when conditions are met.

### Step 5: [Fifth Major Step - e.g., "Integrate External Tools"]

**What we'll do:** Connect Slack, Google Calendar, and other tools

**Time:** ~[X] minutes

**Why integrate:** Streamline workflows by connecting tools your team already uses

---

#### 5.1 [Connect Slack]

**Prerequisites:**
- Slack workspace (free or paid)
- Admin permissions in Slack

**Steps:**

1. **Go to** Settings → **Integrations**

2. **Find** "Slack" in the integrations list

3. **Click** "**Connect**"

4. **You'll be redirected to Slack:**
   - Select your Slack workspace
   - Click "Allow" to grant permissions:
     - Read channel information
     - Post messages
     - Read user information

5. **Choose notification settings:**
   
   **Which Slack channel?**
   - Select: `#marketing` (or create dedicated channel `#campaign-updates`)
   
   **What to post?**
   - ☑️ New tasks created
   - ☑️ Tasks completed
   - ☑️ Task comments
   - ☐ Task assignments (can be noisy)
   - ☑️ Project milestones
   
   **Notification format:**
   - Compact (single line per update)
   - Detailed (includes task description)
   
   **Select:** Detailed

6. **Click** "**Save Integration**"

**✅ Test it:** Create a new task and check if notification appears in Slack

**Expected Slack message:**
```
✅ New task created in "Tutorial: Marketing Campaign Setup"

📝 Write blog post announcing campaign
   Assigned to: @john
   Due: Feb 20, 2026
   Priority: Medium
   
   View task: [Link]
```

---

#### 5.2 [Connect Google Calendar]

**Sync task due dates to your calendar:**

1. **Settings** → **Integrations** → Find "Google Calendar"

2. **Click** "**Connect**"

3. **Log in to Google** and grant permissions:
   - See, edit, share, and permanently delete calendars
   - This allows us to create calendar events for tasks

4. **Configure sync settings:**
   
   **Which calendar?**
   - Create new: `Work Projects` (recommended)
   - Or use existing: `Primary` or `Work`
   
   **Select:** Create new calendar "Work Projects"
   
   **What to sync?**
   - ☑️ Task due dates (creates all-day events)
   - ☑️ Project milestones
   - ☐ All tasks (can clutter calendar)
   
   **Sync only tasks:**
   - Assigned to me
   - OR All tasks in project (select this for team visibility)
   
   **Event details:**
   - Event title format: `[Project] Task Name`
   - Include task description in event: Yes
   - Add video conferencing link: No

5. **Click** "**Connect & Sync**"

**Initial sync:** Takes ~1 minute to sync existing tasks

**Verify:** Check Google Calendar for new "Work Projects" calendar with task events

---

#### 5.3 [Optional: Connect other tools]

**Other integrations available:**

**GitHub** (for development tasks):
- Link tasks to GitHub issues
- Auto-update task status when PR is merged

**Zoom** (for meetings):
- Create Zoom meetings from tasks
- Auto-add meeting links to task descriptions

**Google Drive** (for file storage):
- Attach Drive files to tasks
- Browse Drive directly from project

**Zapier** (for advanced automation):
- Create custom integrations
- Connect to 3,000+ apps

**For this tutorial:** Slack and Google Calendar are sufficient

## Troubleshooting

### Issue: Team member didn't receive invitation

**Possible causes:**
- Email in spam folder
- Email address typo
- Corporate email blocking

**Solutions:**
1. **Check spelling:** Settings → Team → Edit member email
2. **Resend invitation:** Click "Resend" next to member name
3. **Alternative:** Generate invite link and send via Slack/Teams
   - Settings → Team → "Generate Invite Link"
   - Share link directly with team member

---

### Issue: Slack notifications not appearing

**Solutions:**
1. **Check Slack channel:** Verify bot was added to channel
   - In Slack: `/invite @[BotName] to #channel`
2. **Verify integration:** Settings → Integrations → Slack → "Connected" ✅
3. **Check notification settings:** Make sure event types are enabled
4. **Reconnect:** Disconnect and reconnect Slack integration

---

### Issue: Tasks not syncing to Google Calendar

**Solutions:**
1. **Check calendar visibility:**
   - Open Google Calendar
   - Left sidebar: Is "Work Projects" calendar checked?
2. **Force sync:** Settings → Integrations → Google Calendar → "Sync Now"
3. **Check sync settings:** Verify "Task due dates" is enabled
4. **Reconnect:** Disconnect and reconnect Google Calendar integration

---

### Issue: Automation not triggering

**Solutions:**
1. **Check automation status:**
   - Settings → Automation
   - Is automation "Active" ✅ or "Paused" ⏸️?
2. **Verify conditions:** Ensure task meets ALL conditions
   - Example: If automation requires "contains design" in task name, verify exact spelling
3. **Check automation logs:**
   - Settings → Automation → Click automation → "Activity Log"
   - See when it last ran and any errors
4. **Test manually:** Create a test task that should trigger automation

---

### Issue: Can't add custom fields to tasks

**This feature requires:** Pro plan or higher

**Solutions:**
1. **Upgrade plan:** Settings → Billing → Upgrade to Pro
2. **Or use labels instead:** Free alternative to categorize tasks
3. **Or request workspace admin** to upgrade plan

---

### Issue: Project dashboard is slow to load

**Solutions:**
1. **Reduce widgets:** Remove unnecessary widgets
2. **Limit dashboard date range:** Show last 30 days instead of all time
3. **Check browser:** Try different browser or clear cache
4. **Check internet:** Slow connection causes delays

## Appendix

### Glossary

**Terms used in this tutorial:**

- **Project:** A collection of related tasks and resources
- **Task:** Individual action item within a project
- **Section:** Category or group for organizing tasks
- **Automation:** Rule that automatically performs actions
- **Integration:** Connection to external tool/service
- **Custom Field:** User-defined data field on tasks
- **Dashboard:** Overview page showing project metrics
- **Widget:** Individual component on dashboard

---

### Keyboard Shortcuts

**Speed up your workflow:**

| Action | Windows/Linux | Mac |
|--------|---------------|-----|
| **Quick add task** | `Q` | `Q` |
| **Search** | `Ctrl+K` | `Cmd+K` |
| **Open task details** | `Enter` | `Enter` |
| **Mark task complete** | `Ctrl+Enter` | `Cmd+Enter` |
| **Navigate tasks** | `↑` `↓` | `↑` `↓` |
| **Go to Projects** | `P` | `P` |
| **Go to Dashboard** | `D` | `D` |
| **Undo** | `Ctrl+Z` | `Cmd+Z` |

**See all shortcuts:** Press `?` in the app
